# foundry_evaluator_version (Data Source)

~> **Preview:** This data source requires `enable_preview = ["evaluations"]` on the provider. Preview features may change their inputs, outputs, or behavior in any provider release without following semantic versioning.

Looks up a single version of a Foundry evaluator.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Evaluations are a preview feature; opt in on the provider block:
# provider "foundry" {
#   enable_preview = ["evaluations"]
# }

data "foundry_evaluator_version" "relevance" {
  name    = "response-relevance"
  version = "1"
}

output "evaluator_id" {
  value = data.foundry_evaluator_version.relevance.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the evaluator.
- `version` (String) Version of the evaluator to look up.

### Read-Only

- `blob_uri` (String) Blob URI of the Python evaluator source, when `type` is `code`.
- `code_text` (String) Inline Python evaluator source, when `type` is `code`.
- `connection_name` (String) Name of the connection the endpoint evaluator calls, when `type` is `endpoint`.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the evaluator version was created.
- `description` (String) Description of the evaluator version.
- `dimensions` (Attributes List) Scoring dimensions, when `type` is `rubric`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dimensions))
- `display_name` (String) Display name assigned to the evaluator version.
- `id` (String) Service-assigned identifier of this evaluator version.
- `metrics` (Map of String) Metric names produced by this evaluator.
- `modified_at` (String) Timestamp when the evaluator version was last modified.
- `prompt_text` (String) LLM judge prompt template, when `type` is `prompt`.
- `type` (String) Evaluator kind: `prompt`, `code`, `rubric`, or `endpoint`.

<a id="nestedatt--dimensions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dimensions`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description of the dimension shown to the LLM judge.
- `id` (String) Stable identifier of the dimension.
- `weight` (Number) Relative weight of the dimension in the overall rubric score.
